scope: Direct source-context review; all inventoried site start positions linked to reviewed intervals. T temporal/state/order, P price/priority, N declaration or non-temporal control. Preserve original AST operators and outcomes; contextual review not executable equivalence.

contexts.meaning: Module imports, exact Decimal 0.618 constant and records; optional values, validity true and internal false; no formation yet.
String-normalize candle tag to uppercase then compare exact supplied color; no OHLC recomputation.
Map lookup by integer index; only KeyError becomes ValueError with cause; no nearest or fallback candle.

First strict stop in positional slice [max(0,start),end+1) determines result. Convert semantic sourceExtreme and each directional price directly to Decimal; return whether first crossing candle's actual index equals end. Earlier crossing makes false even if final crosses.
Validate direction, B top minus 0.618*(top-reference), R bottom plus 0.618*(reference-bottom). Exact operation order, no quantization.
Get exact Reaction confirmation, lower range [pending source main open, Break main open+timeframe); no lower rows returns null.
Direct Decimal of confirmation-side box. For each lower row, terminate on timestamp > confirmation, else append only strict directional improvement beyond comparison extreme.

After same-row penetration collection, test strict opposite-side Break; with eligible evidence choose directional min/max, first equal extreme preserved. Thus same lower row may both penetrate and confirm; no ordering within row inferred.
Map decisive timestamp to main position; absent/null map entry raises. Return mapped main index/time with decisive lower price; if no crossing+evidence, null.

Compute Fibonacci before other work; if no map build index-keyed candles, later duplicate overwrites. Traverse every integer First..Break inclusive; missing map key errors. Confirming color GREEN B, RED R.
Get Break lower interval and keep timestamp <= exact confirmation, then directional min/max; empty prefix yields null, never full Break OHLC fallback.

Fresh pending/confirmed state. For each main use last confirmed strike or Fibonacci as threshold. Break index uses clipped lower price; other main uses direct Decimal extreme. Null skips entire candle including confirmation color.
Pending replaced iff strict improvement vs threshold and pending absent or strict improvement vs pending. Equality does not replace. Source index/time is current main.
After possible pending update, matching main color confirms existing pending and clears it; same main may create/confirm.
If unresolved pending, run intrabar confirmation using latest confirmed threshold or Fibonacci and pending source main start. Append only nonnull result; return level and confirmed strikes.
Last strike and full mapped main High/Low. Scale drawing B=Low+(High-Low)/3, R=High-(High-Low)/3; preserve Decimal operation order.
Publish decisive strike identity/time/semantic extreme, drawing price from full main, drawing interval +/- timeframe; broken level null and default valid. Drawing interval is not event chronology.
Map Reset source integer index, full main High/Low, Reset drawing divisor 5 and same directional formula.

Reset Blue invalid only if previous line present AND first strict stop in positional slice prior source+1 through Reset is exactly at Reset AND main extreme strictly beyond prior sourceExtreme. Short circuit, equal price not invalid.
Return Reset even invalid; source main index/time and extreme, direct brokenLevel Decimal, drawing +/- timeframe, internal flag. No previous valid check.
Checkpoint holds prior reaction/count, spacing count, output length; tail receives caller lists.
Build map and group resets by First in input order; restore previous/count, any output (including invalid/internal) establishes hasBlue, restore healthy count.
Traverse suffix, 1-based ordinal start+1. Mode A anchor nonnull else leg boundary; both absent error. Clear prior count only; preserve spacing.
Other mode requires prior reaction; prior directional box edge is reference. Compute strikes in current reaction; no speculative chronology.
Scale iff prior count exists AND new count strictly greater AND no Blue or healthy>=1. Emit then set hasBlue, zero healthy and mark scale emitted.
When hasBlue and no Scale this reaction increment healthy once before Reset traversal.

For resets matching current First in supplied order, skip when hasBlue and healthy<1; else emit with previous output line or null, set hasBlue and zero spacing. Same-reaction Scale suppresses Reset; first eligible Reset prevents subsequent reset emission in group.
Set previous reaction and count. Optional checkpoint stores shallow reaction copy, count, healthy and output length. Return same list; prior mutations persist on failure.
Validate exact direction membership then fresh tail with empty output, no checkpoints.
Live initialization same direction validation; initial default checkpoint, compute tail capturing checkpoints.
Result shallow list copy, same line objects.
Existing checkpoint required: 0 <= first_changed < checkpoint count and <= new reaction count; otherwise error.
If dirty main present collect reset First owners whose Reset index >= dirty, scan earlier reactions [0,first_changed); first Break>=dirty OR affected First rewinds frontier.
Select checkpoint, retain inclusive checkpoint prefix and line prefix by count; replay iff first_changed < revised reaction count; replace retained lists only after success; return shallow copy.
Public list retains original order and original objects only when valid(default true) AND not internal(default false); short circuit; no mutation.
Initialize lazy per-call interior index state, not global.

Collect original behavior intervals, skip missing First/confirmation. Any non-exact datetime or timezone-aware disables entire index; else chronological containment index preserves order, including empty.
Ordinal int(falsy->0); outside [1,owner count] false. Otherwise owner flag truthiness; no physical identity validation.
Missing sourceTime/rendered/semantic returns false before index. Convert both through Decimal(string); initialize interior index at most once.
Candidate collection all behavior reactions unless native naive source and index present; query containment. Skip missing times. Require behavior First < source <= confirmation.
Both prices must be strictly inside same public box; equal endpoints fail. No explicit healthy flag test, caller collection controls.
Traverse original lines, owner flag OR geometry predicate short circuit; mutate frozen line internal true, never clear; no rollback.
